title: literature/material_constants.csv
description: One constant per row. The status vocabulary is closed: a value is either VERIFIED against a citable source, DERIVED from verified values, ASSUMED (and then no quantitative claim may rest on it alone), FIXED by convention or exactness, ZERO by crystal symmetry, or VERIFIED_TO_ORDER_OF_MAGNITUDE. Tuned/FITTED/CHOSEN labels are forbidden: a parameter may never be selected to make a validation rule pass (Phase 1B P1-A).

cross_checks.rule: every ASSUMED row must say ASSUMED in notes
value must parse as a float
